The '''C-210 Elite Watchman Saboteur''' was a make of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available on [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] such as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. They were silver in [[Color/Legends|color]] and sold for 135 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Parts of the weapon were modifiable, including its [[Crystal/Legends|color crystal]], though the unmodified version fired [[Color|orange]] blaster bolts.<ref name="TORJR" /><ref name="TORRTD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The C-210 Elite Watchman Saboteur first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] can only be used by members of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] or [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] classes. Smugglers can choose it as a reward from the "Race the Devil" class quest on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and bounty hunters can choose it as a reward from the "Joy Ride" quest on the planet [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. It is not clear where the players acquire the pistol from during the quests. This article makes no assumption about which reward players chose in the respective quests.<ref name="TORJR" /><ref name="TORRTD" />
